problem_statement: The mDNS module should register the device's local host (its name and its assigned IPv4/IPv6 addresses) so the host name and its address records are probed, announced, and answered to DNS queries. A local host name should be retrievable and settable (set only while mDNS is disabled), and platform-reported address add/remove events for the network interface should be reflected in the mDNS announcements and query responses, with transient add-then-remove events suppressed. Before this change the local-host registration API and the host-address-change notification do not exist, so the corresponding behaviour cannot be exercised.
